candidates.summary: Nothing pins the '#'-before-regexp order that keeps the sub-realm refusal under its charge: the PayGasSubRealm bench only checks that the call is refused, and payStorage's identical refusal has no bench at all
candidates.failure_scenario: The body measures a failed pkgpath regexp match on a 256-byte sub-realm token at 16-20 us, against a 9959-gas charge (1097 + 35448*256/1024), and says the IndexByte('#') short-circuit at paygas.go:22 / paystorage.go:21 is what holds it to 0.3 us. Reorder either condition to `!gno.IsRealmPath(pkgPath) || strings.IndexByte(pkgPath, '#') >= 0` and the refusal still fires with the same 'rlm is not a realm' message, so zrealm_paygas.gno, paygas_from_main.txtar, paygas_realm_capability.txtar and BenchmarkNative_Runtime_PayGasSubRealm_256 all stay green, while every recovered refusal costs about twice its charge
candidates.verify_by: In a scratch worktree, swap the two operands at gnovm/stdlibs/chain/runtime/paygas.go:22 and paystorage.go:21, then run go test -count=1 ./gnovm/stdlibs/... and go test -count=1 -run '^$' -bench PayGasSubRealm -benchtime 3000x ./gnovm/cmd/calibrate/: expect red, observe PASS everywhere. grep -rln 'rlm is not a realm' finds only outcome assertions (zrealm_paygas.gno, two txtars, the bench)
candidates.evidence: Read only. The bench at :1005-1028 asserts only `strings.Contains(ex.Sprint(m), "rlm is not a realm")`. grep -rln 'rlm is not a realm' returned gnovm/tests/files/zrealm_paygas.gno, the bench, paygas_from_main.txtar and paygas_realm_capability.txtar, all checking the message and never the cost. No PayStorageSubRealm bench exists. At head under load 62, PayGasSubRealm_256 measured 1981 ns/op and every Runtime_Pay bench PASSed.

candidates.summary: The `bp.MaxGas != -1` conjunct can never be false: MaxGas here is either the testing default of 30B or a -max-gas value, which is set only when positive
candidates.failure_scenario: DefaultTestingGenesisConfig sets MaxGas 30_000_000_000 (node_testing.go:130) and line 284 overrides it only `if *maxGas > 0`, so MaxGas is always positive when line 294 runs. The -1 test mirrors params.go:137 but guards a value this harness cannot produce, and a reader takes it to mean that -max-gas -1 is supported. It is not: the flag ignores -1
candidates.verify_by: sed -n '284,285p;294p' gno.land/pkg/integration/testscript_gnoland.go and sed -n 130p gno.land/pkg/integration/node_testing.go: MaxGas is either 30B or a positive flag value; no other write to Block.MaxGas sits between them
